brief: A recipe manager as a transformation timeline — ingredients flow through steps and combine into the dish

dominant_strengths: Clear left-to-right transformation metaphor with stage icons makes the recipe-as-pipeline concept legible at a glance
Each stage uses a distinct accent color tied to its emoji icon, giving the timeline rhythm and recognizable phase identity
Information hierarchy within cards is solid: stage title, then chip-style steps, with quantities right-aligned in ingredients
dominant_weaknesses: Five different saturated icon hues plus pastel chip backgrounds create chromatic noise rather than a curated palette
Connector arrows are inconsistent — some overlap chip text (Sear chicken, Mince garlic) revealing layout collisions and weak craft
The Final Dish uses a cartoon emoji on a flat gradient, which feels juvenile next to the otherwise utilitarian dashboard tone
fix_priorities: Fix arrow placement so connectors route between cards, not through chip labels
Reduce palette to two semantic hues (prep vs heat) and desaturate chip fills for calmer scanning
Replace emoji-on-gradient final dish with real imagery or refined illustration to match the manager's seriousness
Tighten typography scale — stage titles, chip text, and quantity labels currently feel like three unrelated systems
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity leads thanks to the explicit pipeline, but visceral polish is undermined by clashing colors and reflective depth is shallow since the metaphor stops at visualization.
rationale.intent_fit: It does literalize the transformation-timeline brief, but the flow is more diagrammatic than alive — ingredients don't visibly combine or move into the final dish.
